gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew reads sturdy, with a midsection that swallows the line. Amatic SC does quirky, hand-squeezed charm best, while the body font handles wide, open curves with quiet efficiency.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-hk: Quirky rope-like lines make Amatic SC feel hand-made and a bit rustic. And Noto Sans HK sets large, tidy lowercase beneath, giving that wobble something sturdy to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads approachable, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers. But make Amatic SC small and its unmodulated, toothpaste-like line quickly loses its rustic swagger.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: A toothpaste-squeezed stroke defines Amatic SC, with terminals stopping well short of the stem. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian gives that wild line a deep, tidy band to stand on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-jp: Scrappy rope-thin lines, then a tall, open body: Amatic SC sketches while Noto Sans JP stands up straight. One feels doodled in a notebook, the other feels cleanly typed and tidy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada reads friendly and contemporary, with gentle bumps up to the capitals. And Amatic SC drops in a rustic, quirky line, so the two feel like sketch and print.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li keeps its capitals only slightly above the lowercase, with lifted brush ends. And since Amatic SC wobbles like bent tubing, let the sans body run a touch larger.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Loose marker lines, then chiselled openness: Noto Sans Khmer keeps its small letters nearly capital-sized. And Amatic SC is best at rustic charm, while the sans-serif body is best at plain legibility.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Approachable at heart, Noto Sans Lepcha stands its lowercase up with the stature of cast iron capitals. And Amatic SC adds its quirky, constant stroke on top, so the two feel loose and sturdy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Beneath Amatic SC, with its one-marker-tip line, paragraphs would settle into an approachable rhythm, wide openings keeping the going gentle.
